exposure: Mode of delivery (Cesarean section vs vaginal delivery)
outcome: Cognitive development at 5 years of age
Scores on Bender Visual Motor Gestalt Test (BG test)
Scores on Raven Colored Progressive Matrices (RCPM test)
cohort: Two cohorts of 5-year-old children born in 2013 and 2014 in Karvina (Northern Moravia) and Ceske Budejovice (Southern Bohemia) (n = 168, n = 117 vaginal delivery, n = 51 cesarean delivery)
finding: Children born via cesarean section scored significantly lower on cognitive tests (BG and RCPM) at 5 years of age compared to children born vaginally.
mod_finding: Cesarean-born children scored notably lower on cognitive tests compared to vaginally born children, suggesting a potential adverse effect of cesarean delivery on cognitive development.
